csv_scope_of_work: Western Office Chiller & HVAC Replacement. Design, bidding, construction administration, and closeout services to evaluate and design the replacement of an existing chiller system and mini-splits serving the DNCR Western Office in Asheville, NC. The project will consist of a like-for-like replacement of the existing chiller system and 5 commercial mini-splits, evaluation of the existing air distribution system, and modernization of the HVAC controls.
